name: Balls V2 Total V1
author: AAidalol
description: A remake of the level 'Balls V1 Total' that was intentionally named to be very confusing. Also the first level Aida played on her pointer finger in a while. The name implies that it is the second version of the first version, hence v1... v2. Has a possible 240 FPS frame perfect first ship click. Hardest part is 0-25.
